The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] maintained an '''embassy''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] sometime well before the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The embassy was destroyed by a [[Nyranos's father|Kaleesh]], who was convicted of the crime and given a life sentence of [[Prison/Legends|imprisonment]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]].<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Kashyyyk embassy was first mentioned in the Codex entry for the group of [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] known as the [[Condemned]] in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Codex" />
